entities.summary: Karl Artur Vilhelm Moberg was a Swedish journalist, author, playwright, historian, and debater. His literary career, spanning more than 45 years, is associated with his four‑volume series The Emigrants. The novels, published between 1949 and 1959, deal with the Swedish emigration to the United States in the 19th century. They have been adapted for a total of three movies, and a musical. Vilhelm Moberg was a journalists & chroniclers from Moshultamåla (1898-08-20, Moshultamåla–1973-08-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
